g.text: What `docker swarm init` sets up on a node
Verified on Docker 29.9.2: ingress VNI 4096 (10.0.0.0/24); gwbridge 172.18.0.0/16; user overlays 4097, 4098, ...
swarm ID, a root CA + certificates (mutual TLS between nodes),
subnet 172.18.0.0/16: the way out to the world
A container attached to an overlay network
Troubleshooting hint: if containers reach each other over the overlay but not the Internet, look at the docker_gwbridge/NAT path or net.ipv4.ip_forward.
